programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: La Lucha de un Guerrero (2025)
programme.desc: Om es un súper comando que tiene la importante misión de devolver al Rashtra Kavach (que literalmente se traduce como guardia de seguridad del país) a buenas manos y salvar la nación. Está a punto de completar su misión cuando recibe un disparo y vuelve a la vida solo para darse cuenta de que ha perdido la memoria. Mientras tanto, Kavya Sharma se ocupa de él mientras otros funcionarios de la agencia gubernamental de élite, Murthy y Jai Rathod, están ocupados pensando cómo hacer que Om regrese a la misión. Pero no es tan sencillo como parece desde fuera. Mientras salva a su nación, Om tiene mucho más por descubrir: por ejemplo, encontrar a su padre Dev Rathod y demostrar que no era un traidor.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

Resulta que ganarse el respeto, encontrar el amor y descubrir su identidad no es tan fácil. Tendrá que luchar para llegar a la cima.

programme.title: Eva Braun
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath

Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

Love, hot chocolate and an unexpected connection will bring Marcus and Colette together for the holidays.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Miles de familias colombianas buscan tener casa propia, pero muchas son engañadas. En Flandes, Freddy Hernández y su esposa Edna también fueron víctimas de un proyecto sin permisos. Las autoridades investigan.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Aguachica, un joven prometió grandes ganancias con criptomonedas, pero desapareció con el dinero de los inversionistas. En Bogotá, Daniel Gómez ofreció rentabilidades del 8% con su empresa Taurex, pero tampoco cumplió. La criptomoneda Daily Cop también dejó a miles sin su dinero. Las estafas suman millones de dólares.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.sub-title: El Crimen De María Mercedes Gnecco Parte 3
programme.desc: El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco sigue siendo un enigma. José Manuel Gnecco, principal sospechoso, insiste en su inocencia, mientras nuevas pruebas y la controversia sobre el arma homicida complican aún más el caso.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ante la creciente delincuencia y la ineficacia policial, los ciudadanos recurren a la seguridad privada, la unión y vigilancia organizada surgen como respuesta urgente, evidenciando vacíos en la justicia y protección policial.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Tame, Arauca, un militar fue condenado a 60 años por violar y asesinar brutalmente a tres niños. El Tribunal Superior de Bogotá lo encontró culpable de acceso carnal violento y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Una historia de amor en Barranquilla termina en tragedia en Canadá. Patricia es asesinada por su esposo al descubrir infidelidad. Tras un juicio, él es condenado. Los hijos quedan al cuidado del hermano de Daniel.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Andrés Felipe Fierro, joven ingeniero ambiental, fue asesinado en 'Charco Azul', Florencia, Caquetá. La investigación reveló que Rocío Quintero, su amante, y Jarol Villegas, esposo de ella, estuvieron involucrados en el crimen. Un testigo clave confirmó las sospechas. Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En 1993, Nancy Mestre, de 18 años, fue violada y asesinada por Jaime Saade Cormane tras salir con él en Nochevieja. Su padre, Martín, nunca se rindió: pasó 27 años investigando hasta descubrir que Saade había huido a Brasil bajo una nueva identidad. Gracias a su persistencia, fue capturado en 2020, aunque la extradición a Colombia sigue pendiente.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Carmenza López exige respuestas sobre el asesinato de su esposo Guillermo Leal, edil de Sumapaz secuestrado por las FARC en 2008. Aunque recibió un cuerpo, ella duda que fueran sus restos. Trece años después, sigue buscando la verdad, ahora como miembro de la Mesa de víctimas de Sumapaz, enfrentando a los desmovilizados sin darles el perdón que aún no siente merecido.

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: Ahora es mi marido. ¡No es el padre de tu bebé!
programme.desc: Estos invitados dicen que están seguros de saber quién es el padre de sus hijos, pero necesitan una prueba de ADN para comprobarlo. Ahora los resultados están a punto de descubrirse, pero ¿serán los resultados que esperaban?

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: Solo tengo 17 años... ¿Mi novio se acostó con mi mamá?
programme.desc: El año pasado, Maurice fue descubierto engañando a Karen en The Maury Show y ha vuelto con su nueva prometida, Shauntia. ¿Sigue siendo infiel? Entonces, Destanee, de 17 años, cree que el padre de su bebé la engaña... ¡con su madre!

programme.title: Maury

programme.title: Steve Wilkos

programme.title: Steve Wilkos

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts from Clitheroe, revealing more interesting valuables. Discoveries include one of the earliest vacuum cleaners, a collection of porcelain pugs, a 17th-century gate-leg table, and a superbly painted plant pot.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the roadshow to Abergavenny in Wales. Treasures include a copy of a James Bond book bought for 50 pence, an art deco dollhouse, and a 17th-century spoon worth 2,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel's experts visit Mount Stewart in County Down, Northern Ireland, where they assess a badly damaged painting valued between 20 and 30,000, a souvenir from Laurel and Hardy, and Henry Sandon is introduced to a mug bearing his spitting image.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team returns to Mount Stewart in Northern Ireland, where their finds include a silver tea set presented to mark an officer's bravery at the battle of Trafalgar, a rare Wedgwood cup and saucer, and a teddy bear that has been in a box for 40 years.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the experts are in England, Woburn Abbey in Bedfordshire. Treasured items brought to light include a rare washing bowl for beards, a portrait of a handsome cat valued at 18,000 pounds, and a Victorian bracelet that imitates a snake.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A Victorian multi-purpose penknife, a miniature theatre, and a Japanese lacquered chest of astonishing rarity and considerable value are among the treasures discovered on a visit to Clitheroe in Lancashire.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents from Scarborough in North Yorkshire, where the artifacts include a rare surviving roll of Beatles wallpaper, the passport once belonging to the world's smallest man, and examples of some of the finest carved whales teeth.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the roadshow team are in St Ives, Cambridgeshire. They assess an early pocket calculator, a valuable jug bought for a fiver, and a traction engine arrives in full steam.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Haslar in Gosport and assess a satinwood secretaire, a radiograph of Edward VIII's hand, an Edward Lear sketch, a gold-painted bronze, a Steiff teddy, and ceremonial silverware given by Tsar Nicolas II to HMS Lion.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Wigan in Greater Manchester. Amongst the featured items are an Art Nouveau cabinet, a cache of silver buried in World War Two, and an early depiction of women's rights.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and his team of experts visit the London to Brighton Veteran Car Run, where they invite members of the public to bring along their prized possessions for expert examination.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit the RHS gardens at Wisley. Amongst the pieces under scrutiny are an early fortune teller's caravan and a credenze with a potential value of 100,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the team of experts to the Royal Horticultural Society gardens at Wisley. The treasures coming to light are a set of letters written by Lewis Carroll and a valuable carriage clock saved from a skip.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the village of Portmeirion in North Wales. Amongst the treasures brought to light are intricate 18th Century mosaics and items made by prisoners of war as gifts.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head for Haltwhistle in Northumberland. Amongst the discoveries made are original fittings from the Titanic's sister ship, the Olympic, a roman coin, and a letter from JRR Tolkein.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Antiques Roadshow team head for the seaside. In Hastings, the treasures uncovered are a Meissan pot, a sketch by artist Augustus John, and an unopened wedding gift from the 1920s.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits Witley Court in Worcestershire where they discover the complete cast of an early puppet theatre, a Worcester plate, a drawing by LS Lowry, and a piece of Staffordshire slipware.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the Magna Centre in Rotherham. Amongst the items brought to light are a rare clock given by Queen Victoria, a stash of silver, and some Beatles memorabilia.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A featherweight battle between this week’s rounds. Robots that weigh no more than 12kg battle to join the other qualifiers. The main competition proceeds as evenly matched robots do anything they can to get the upper hand.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Canada and Switzerland both battle in the World Championship Qualifier special event. The heats near their end and spots for the final are filling up rapidly and to a high standard.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: It’s all-out war as Refbot is immobilised and Sir Killalot may have finally met his match. One round ends exceptionally quickly. Another World Championship Qualifier between three Dutch robots is this week’s special event.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last of the heats, the final eight robots that have a chance of making it to the Grand Final, will they seize the opportunity or choke under the pressure? A featherweight champion will be revealed in this week’s special event.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight of the heat winners gather for the first Semi-Finals. With two rounds to prove themselves, only two robots will make it to the Grand Finals. Competitors show no mercy as they use any means necessary to eliminate their opponents.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One competitor’s weapon proves fatal for their opposition, crushing their hopes of a title with a single blow, whilst other unlucky robots are removed from not only the arena, but also the competition.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Grand Final is here as the series draws to an explosive end. With every battle being so well matched, the judges have their work cut out for them as they decide which robot, will become Robot Wars: The Seventh Wars champions.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.sub-title: The Seventh Wars - Third World Championship
programme.desc: Twelve Robots from across the globe once again gather in the arena for the Third World Championship. Eliminator style rounds will decide which robots progress through to the finals, where a winner will be crowned.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Let the battle for the Third Wars crown commence. With the trials being replaced with all out combat, this series is set to be the most brutal yet.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Teams from across the UK enter the arena in hopes of besting the house robots and making it to the Grand Final. The knockouts keep on coming as eight more competitors think they have what it takes to survive the Robot Wars.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight fresh competitors ready to prove their mettle in the arena. Featuring a special event, Middleweight Melee, a single exhibition battle between five robots weighing under 45.4kg.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: As the knockouts continue to streamline the competition, this week’s special has separate competitors trying to knock-down objects and hit targets to score the most points in Pinball Warriors.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last robot football of The Third Wars in this week’s special. A spot in the final isn’t the only thing the heat final can offer one of the competitors this week.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: More heat winners are pitted against each other in knockout competition. The robots attempt to ram, flip and burn their way to the finals, all while trying to avoid the house robots.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.sub-title: The Third Wars - First World Championship
programme.desc: Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eva quiere una boda con su novio, pero su madre tiene planes de casarla con una mujer adinerada. Luis es muy macho y demanda a su amigo gay por divulgar que ellos tuvieron relaciones sexuales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anayansi desea recuperar la custodia de su hijo, pero la abuela se rehúsa. También, la hija de Cristian y Andrea tiene una enfermedad gastrointestinal que están tratando con excremento.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Abigaíl descubre que su hermana tiene una relación amorosa con el hombre que la violó. Samantha y Enrique son ruidosos en el sexo y esto ha afectado a su hijo adolescente, quien es invidente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Leticia abusa sexualmente del hijo de Cintia, ambos menores de 10 años, la niña está presa. Robinson somete a su nieta con autismo a un tratamiento que provoca daños cerebrales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Atención medica y sexual urgente; Café de elefante
programme.desc: Jeanlin descubre que su "roommate" se prostituye y quiere desalojarla. José demanda a Elvis porque no le pagó el café que le sirvió en su reunión de negocios, y cuyo grano lo defeca un animal.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El maltratado; Paco y los calzoncillos
programme.desc: Claribel quiere la custodia de su hermano con daño cerebral, porque su cuñada abusa de él por venganza. Carlos pierde un testículo por la picada de un guacamayo y responsabiliza a su esposa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Una vida por otra; Conejillo de indias
programme.desc: Armando necesita al hijo de su esposa secuestrada para intercambiarlo por ella, pero el chico está en manos de su cuñado. Stefany quiere que su esposo deje de someterse a estudios clínicos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Si te fuiste, a qué has vuelto; Mama's Boy
programme.desc: Luz América intenta ir al funeral de su hija, pero su hermana y su madre lo impiden. Yarelis cuida a su hijo de 18 años como si fuera un bebé, el padre quiere que el chico se vaya de la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El novio de Laura le cuidaba la mascota, el animal ingiere cocaína y aparece muerto. Andrés le practica sexo oral a su mujer durante la menstruación, le causa lesiones físicas y psicológicas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joan tiene la custodia total de su hija y Yuri descubre que la niña hace videos de "autobullying". En otro caso, la serpiente de Ángel y Rose se come al lindo perro de su vecina Katiana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Duplo golpe emocional; Balines contra iguanas
programme.desc: Verónica demanda a su hermana por estafa emocional, la acusa de sacarle dinero. Benjamín le dispara a Iván, quien es indocumentado, alega que fue un accidente porque quería matar a una iguana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liz y Joan tienen una hija albina, a quien le afecta vivir en Miami por su condición, la madre quiere irse del país. Bárbara exige que Rafael y Albert paguen por robarle sus clientes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hermano abusa a hermano; Universidad de influencers
programme.desc: Anthony exige que su hermano Edgard le pague por haberlo violado. Una madre se niega a entregarle dinero a su hijo para sus estudios, ella alega que no escogió una carrera profesional.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny sufre un accidente tras enterarse de que uno de sus hijos no es suyo. Simón y Dolores están en pleno acto sexual, cuando el esposo de ella los sorprende, le mutila el miembro al amante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La recompensa; Bendito sea mi padre
programme.desc: Una mujer quiere obtener la recompensa que ofrecen por su marido, un ladrón prófugo de la justicia. Por otro lado, Marina se entera de que un cura ha demostrado ser su padre. Por si fuera poco, este obtuvo su custodia y planea llevársela a Panamá.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Odio y desalojo; The Gold Digger
programme.desc: Quiere desalojarlos por conflictivos, ellos creen que los discrimina. Mirela llega a un acuerdo con José para quedarse con la pensión de su padre, pero el plan se cae cuando aparece la viuda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tres hermanas se disputan la herencia de la madre, una dice que la división debe ser entre dos. La esposa de Santiago gana un buen sueldo, pero tienen que vivir en la ciudad más cara del país.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Un golpe bajo; Manatí al grill
programme.desc: Está obsesionada y por celos ataca a la novia de su vecino, él la golpea y ahora ella quiere que la cuide. Yoli quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo porque su esposo come manatíes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ahogamiento tardío; La muda y el pastel
programme.desc: La niña muere por el agua alojada en sus pulmones, su madre culpa al papá. Marina queda muda cuando su hijastra le empuja la cara contra el pastel y se perfora las cuerdas vocales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Con todo el peso encima; Iglesia de la marihuana
programme.desc: Cree que su esposa quiere que regrese solo por una herencia, ella pide que se haga un bypass gástrico. La madre exige custodia total de su hija, el papá es pastor de la iglesia de la marihuana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No se consumó; Fornicando la tierra
programme.desc: Tras un accidente, mantienen intimidad como pueden, pero ella ya no aguanta más. Una congregación incita a sus fieles a tener sexo con la naturaleza y Celeste exige que le devuelvan el diezmo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrea hace churros con la receta de Isabel y le explotan en la cara, pide dinero para gastos médicos. Yuli atiende su heladería en 'body painting', exige que Brenda deje en paz a sus clientes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tres mujeres demandan a Jotsy por estafa, él se casó con ellas para luego abandonarlas. También, Ángela quiere que la reintegren en el coro, pero la directora no la acepta de regreso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela se defiende cuando la difaman, porque en su empresa hay una habitación para que los empleados tengan sexo. Lorenzo demanda a su madre, por su culpa no pudo ser pelotero profesional.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: A corazón abierto; A los 70 también se termina
programme.desc: Daniela necesita un trasplante de corazón y su hija, con muerte cerebral, puede ser la donante; pero ella está embarazada y su pareja se opone. Anciana exige el divorcio por falta de atención.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Microchip para mi madre; O te casas o te mueres
programme.desc: Manuela quiere someter a su madre a una cirugía experimental e implantar un chip en su cerebro. Eliana le pide matrimonio a la hija de Liliana a través de un video, pero con una soga al cuello.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Me convertí en otra persona; Orgía VIH
programme.desc: Cristopher es un hombre heterosexual, casado y con hijos, que siente la necesidad de vestirse de mujer. Carolina quiere tener sexo con Jorge para contagiarse de VIH, él cree que es una locura.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No más indocumentados; Borracha manejando auto de juguete
programme.desc: Andrés acusa a Gregory por racista, lo culpa de la deportación de su padre. María causa un accidente al conducir un auto de juguete bajo efectos del alcohol, su hermana la demanda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tiene ascendencia árabe y lo despiden porque sus rezos asustan al dueño de la empresa. Julián quiere terminar su relación con Lina porque cree que su pareja solo siente deseo por ella misma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: En Internet, circula un video de Santiago en el baño gracias a una cámara oculta en la casa que alquiló. Por otro lado, Geovani y Nixon son pareja en un videojuego y se pelean por dinero.

programme.title: ARV: Archivo oculto
programme.desc: Misterios reales captados en cámara, donde lo paranormal, lo alienígena y la fe desafían la lógica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras ser descubierta la casa de seguridad, Aurelio ordena evacuarla. Mónica trata de llevarse a Isidro con ella, pero es detenida por Ninón; ambas discuten. Robles es forzada a dejar al niño.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a Casillas y le pide que tenga piedad con Esperanza, porque ella no tuvo la culpa de que la DEA la capturara. Aurelio es tajante y sella su destino. Un video de Terán lo compromete.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y sus secuaces observan a Tony y Esperanza. Casillas lleva a Pina y a Juan Carlos para el intercambio por su hija e ignora sus súplicas. Castillo y Colón van al punto de la negociación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Salvatierra y Salazar llegan en helicóptero a rescatar a Esperanza, pero algo sale mal. Mónica termina su relación con Pastrana y jura acabar con Ninón, con tal de recuperar a su hijo, Isidro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javier y Rutila se enteran del plan de los colombianos, de no venderle más coca a los mexicanos y son encerrados por Quezada. Pretenden deshacerse de ellos. Leandro quiere una alianza con Tony.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio viaja a Colombia para intentar rescatar a Rutila. Tony llega y reconoce a Javi. Por otro lado, se acercan la Felina y Raymundo. La casa de Leandro Quezada está rodeada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pastrana está en manos de Aurelio, después que Eunice lo entregara a cambio de Ninón. Como cazador a su presa, Casillas y Skinny lo persiguen. A sangre y fuego, la muerte rodea a todos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: A la caza de Aurelio Casillas
programme.desc: El Cabo y sus aliados del narcotráfico regresan para ser dueños del negocio y acabar con Casillas y todos los integrantes de su familia. Hieren a Ismael y Javier es víctima de un atentado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En cadena nacional, Aurelio Casillas desafía a los narcos de Colombia y deja mal parado al presidente. Se escabulle en medio de un operativo policial. Corina le revela que es de la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La agente especial de la DEA le asegura a Casillas que no lo vendió y está dispuesta a dar su vida por él; pero Aurelio no le cree. Javi despierta, desmemoriado. Quezada prepara su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Atacan a Casillas y a Rutila
programme.desc: Llega la hora de la venganza y Leandro Quezada tiene la oportunidad de deshacerse de El Señor de Los Cielos y de su hija. El Cabo ordena a Jaime conseguirle una cita con el presidente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El negocio del narcotráfico se mueve rápido: Casillas coquetea con Maldonado en la selva y el Cabo soborna al jefe del estado mayor de México. Buscan extraditar a Aurelio y al presidente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las narcotienditas se quedan sin mercancía y Casillas no tiene cómo conseguirla. El Cabo triunfa en el negocio y jura sacarlo de la jugada. Aurelio hace el amor con Corina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Narcos mexicanos y colombianos luchan por el dominio del territorio y la sangre corre por las calles. Aurelio mata a un policía y el Cabo ordena atropellar al Mocho para evitar que hable.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas recibe la ubicación del Secretario de Seguridad, Castillo, en bandeja de plata, tal como Corina se lo prometió. El Cabo niega la alianza de Quezada. Quiere al pez gordo solo para él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas y sus hombres raptan a Castillo y lo liberan, con la condición de que encarcele al presidente de México. Zuleta chantajea a Terán y logra que acepte la junta con el Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y el presidente pactan eliminar a Casillas. Terán obtendrá votos y control de los carteles y el Cabo su venganza. Zuleta mintió y queda en evidencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rumbo a Turquía, Casillas y Ámbar Maldonado van por negocios y desatan el juego de la seducción: el Águila blanca debe sacar el demonio que ella lleva por dentro. Corina está celosa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Quezada y sus hombres matan a sangre fría a los lugartenientes del Cabo y se quedan a cargo de un laboratorio, dejándole claro con quién debe negociar. Casillas y Ámbar pasean, como enamorados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.sub-title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E01
programme.desc: Enter a world where craftsmanship meets art at a microscopic level. For the first time ever, high-definition cameras equipped with super-macro lenses reveal the inner workings of some of the most delicate and exquisite timepieces ever created. Two-thousand-year-old-bones may be evidence, never before seen, of an actual crucifixion from the time of Jesus. They may reveal that the classic depiction of Jesus on the cross is not how crucifixions were actually carried out in the 1st Century.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.sub-title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E02
programme.desc: A recently discovered Dead Sea Scrolls fragment may be the oldest reference to Jesus ever found. It may have been written in Aramaic by some of his earliest disciples. Outside the ancient city of Jericho there is evidence that the same Roman Army that oppressed Christians may have been secretly worshipping Jesus.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.sub-title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E03
programme.desc: The eruption of Vesuvius may have been the catalyst for the spread of Christianity in the Roman Empire. Have archeologists found the earliest reference to "Christians" in Pompeii? How did our current alphabet evolve? Perhaps from adaptations of Egyptian hierogylphics? How did the symbols become associated with sounds? Travel from Toronto to Serabit El Kadim in Egypt as we look for answers to how we got to our 26 letter alphabet.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.sub-title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E04
programme.desc: There are literally hundreds of food references in the Bible, but the Bible lists ingredients - not recipes. Learn how to make olive oil as they did in ancient times and find out more about the meat, grains and beans eaten in biblical times and how they were prepared. There is new evidence to suggest that the cross was used as a symbol of Christianity far earlier than the time of Constantine. Excavations in Herculaneum and Bethsaida tell a new story about the adoption of the cross as a representation of faith.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.sub-title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E05
programme.desc: Around 733 B.C., ten of the twelve tribes of Israel were conquered and exiled by the Assyrian Empire. Where did the Gadarenes of Gadara go when they were exiled? Can we trace them through to the 21st Century in Europe? Is there any archeological proof for the tradition that Christ carried his cross and stopped in certain locations on the way to Calvary? We follow The Stations Of The Cross to find out what traces may remain in present-day Jerusalem.

programme.sub-title: Aliens Uncovered: The Land of Legends Part 2

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo lee una carta de Celia pidiéndole casarse con Manuela y cuidar a sus hijos. Katiuska contrata a Renato para eliminar a Manuela. programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo cancela su boda con Katiuska tras descubrir que robó el testamento. programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Tras la desaparición de Ricardito, robado por Carrero, Manuela y Ricardo viven una pesadilla. Katiuska finge ayudar pero planea vengarse al saber que Ricardo aún ama a Manuela. programme.title: Episodio 99 (2026)
programme.desc: Los delincuentes liberan a Leticia tras el secuestro. Eustoquio se roba los documentos del Hato de Perijá del despacho de Rivero. programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro abraza a Rosa confesándole su amor, mientras Rosalía los espia y jura vengarse. Adolfo despide oficialmente a Vilma frente a Salvador. programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Natalia advierte a Alejandro que Erasto lo acusó del robo y le aconseja cuidarse. Isaías y Marisela se prometen abandonar el alcohol pero rompen su promesa. programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia felicita a Milagros por el comercial que hizo, le dice que se tome libre el resto del día, y le dice que cada vez se parece más a lo que le hubiera gustado que fuera su hija perdida. programme.desc: Agustín decide darle el divorcio a Magdalena, y la tenencia de Rodrigo, pero a cambio de eso quiere quedarse con la galería de arte. Julieta está a punto de enterarse de la verdad, de parte de Valentina, pero su madre, Ana Belén llega a casa de Valentina. Anteriormente no quiso escuchar a su papá, Efraín. Nayarí se encuentra preparando los carnavales. Antonio consiguió trabajo junto a Agustín, en la galería de arte. programme.desc: Venancio encuentra a Lázara con Pablo Barranco y éste como es de esperar le hace un escándalo por celos. Sin darse cuenta que Carlos Enrique es testigo de este escándalo escucha toda la discusión de Venancio y Lázara. Allí Carlos Enrique escucha de un tal Pablo y empieza a tener un ataque de celos por Lázara, lo cual lo confunde porque debería estar celoso de su esposa Nancy, pero lejos de ello se enceguece y le pide explicaciones a Lázara sobre Pablo. Cuando Lázara creía que era imposible el romance con Carlos Enrique era imposible por estar casado, éste se presenta pidiéndole explicaciones del tal Pablo. programme.desc: Julieta no quiere hablar con Valentina ni con su madre, está muy enojada y no confía en nadie, siente que todos le ocultan cosas. programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode, Sandra McLemore invites you to experience Austria like never before—through its royal palaces, charming villages, and centuries-old traditions. Wander through Schönbrunn Palace after hours, uncovering secret passageways, regal ballrooms, and stories of Empress Sisi. Then, watch a master pastry chef craft the perfect apple strudel—Vienna’s most iconic dessert. The journey continues to Dürnstein, a fairytale village in the Wachau Valley, where apricot orchards, wine, and UNESCO charm steal the spotlight. And in Hallstatt, go underground for an epic adventure through the world’s oldest working salt mine—slides, miner’s gear, and all. Along the way, Sandra shares must-know travel tips for making the most of your Austrian escape. From imperial elegance to alpine thrills, this episode blends history, culture, and flavor into one unforgettable journey.

programme.title: Blood Brothers (2024)
programme.desc: Nicola Bellizzi returns to Naples, after spending six years in a juvenile detention centre, determined to get out of his outcast status and become a lawyer. In the neighbourhood, Gaetano, known as Core e' Fierro, is the absolute boss of the guapperia. A clash takes place between the two young men; but the behaviour of Nicola, who defends Gaetano from the commissioner Ajossa who has caught them duelling, gives rise to a deep friendship between the two. After many denials, driven by necessity, Nicola agrees to become a guappo in turn during an initiation at the secret court to which he is introduced by Core e' Fierro. Lucia, Gaetano's woman, feels attracted to Nicola, but the two repress their desire. Ajossa wants to get his hands on Gaetano and sets a trap for Lucia, inducing her to yield to him in order to save her lover, so that the latter, in order to avenge the offence, will make a mistake.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.desc: In a headline-grabbing case, 22-year-old Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, just hours after reports of an altercation between Sheena and her fiancé, Joe, now 48. Her death was ruled a suicide, but Sheena's parents refuse to believe that their daughter would take her own life -- they feel she was murdered, and that Joe may be responsible. In an effort to clear his name, Joe comes face to face with Sheena's mother and father, Kelly and David, on Dr. Phil's stage. What does Joe say happened on the night Sheena was last seen alive? And, how does his story differ from the one Kelly and David say they've pieced together? Listen to 911 calls from that night, including one from Sheena herself. Tune in and decide for yourself: Is there more to this story than Joe is revealing?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents, Kelly and David, say they believe their daughter was murdered, and have since been working relentlessly to reopen the investigation into her death, which is now under review. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Were there clues missed in the original investigation? Then, Joe says he believed Sheena was suicidal in the days leading up to her death -- so why did he leave her alone in the hotel room after a heated argument? Does his story add up? programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors investigates Hollywood’s Adderall epidemic. Former Hollywood “It-girl” says Adderall destroyed her life. What’s behind the increase in adult ADHD and is it a valid diagnosis? Safer alternatives for stimulant drugs. A procedure that gives a keyhole pout.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From lips and legs to labor and libido, The Doctors explores the “L” words everyone loves or loathes and gives you the tools to start feeling and looking your absolute best! And find out the best ways to fight lethargy.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Learn the truth about your best and worst health habits in an all-new hour with Dr. Travis! Concerned about the recent meningitis outbreak? Get must-know info to keep your family safe. Plus, new, FDA-approved weight loss pills. Could they work for you? The Doctors dress up as their favorite talk show hosts! And, Modern Family star Julie Bowen shares her spookiest health story. Could it happen to you? Plus, the candy that’s as harmful to your teeth as battery acid and more hair-raising health statistics.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: I am a Munchausen by Proxy victim! Woman breaks her silence on medical abuse after several medical records and Doctors suggest her own mother intentionally kept her sick! Could the allegations be true? Win big prizes with The Word of The Day Giveaway!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Embarrassing, Gross, and Wild Special brings you some of The Doctors’ most unforgettable moments! See “The Great Pop-Off”! Relive Dr. Pimple Popper’s biggest and best pops! Marvel at the courage of guests who shared Their most embarrassing problems to raise awareness! From the huge, painful keloids that isolated a school teacher to The severe birthmarks that tormented a young woman, These guests stepped out of the shadows for help. Don’t miss one man’s 315-pound transformation! Laugh and learn as Dr. Ordon and NBA star Jon Salley undergo prostate exams backstage! Score a simple fix for dry, chalky elbows.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Are you your own worst critic? From sweaty armpits to thick ankles, see new solutions for your most “embarrassing” body problems. And, get simple, at-home remedies for brittle nails.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: We’re tackling everything from your common questions to your most embarrassing questions in our medical confessional! Then, The “Stool Squad” is back to answer all your bathroom-related questions! And, fixes for a chubby face without going under the knife! And, The surprising reason why one woman’s nose is constantly running for 7 years. Then, Dr. Nita reveals the everyday habit that could lead to a yeast infection! Next, new research says sparkling water is making you fat. But is true? And, we’re revealing the top hacks to ease your winter driving woes!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: You won’t believe what happens when the show’s cameras go “Inside The O.R.” as a 51-year-old woman has a large fibroid removed, which left her looking 5 months pregnant! Controversial new study claims smart women should marry down if They want to start a family. E-cigarettes and vaping have been sold as a way for smokers to quit – new research on why it doesn’t work? The Doctors’ Court: woman arrested with five different types of drugs hidden…in her vagina?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Why is This Happening to Me?
programme.desc: From bed wetting to plantar warts, The Doctors answer the big question: why is this happening to me? Don’t miss the simple procedure that eliminates crow’s feet, and find out Dr. Ordon’s tips to prevent them from forming!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Have you ever had a medical problem so embarrassing that you didn't even want to talk to your doctor about it? The Doctors answer all the questions you're too embarrassed to ask! Learn how to treat these ailments in the privacy of your own home.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A young man proposes in the ER in his hospital gown and the moment goes completely viral! Now, in a The Doctors exclusive, The couple shares their story, from what nearly took his life to the moment she said yes … and they’re in for a big surprise! A runner fights off a brutal attack with self-defense! Hear her remarkable story and safety tips for you! A woman endures years of teasing for her tiny teeth; can they be fixed? Then, what if your drinking water was hot pink? Would you drink it? One town recently dealt with this issue! A new study confirms how much urine is in the average pool! What you need to know before your next swim! The guide to being a “fab mom”! Plus, the fridge mistakes spoiling your food fast!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Backaches, allergies and toothaches are among the most common recurring health problems. Find out how to keep your chronic medical issues from coming back, and learn to keep body odor and bad breath at bay.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Mom accused of feeding her own kids dog feces? ASMR dandruff scraping? Why some are soothed by watching people scrape their scalps! Is elderly drinking on the rise? The medical trend that could be harming your grandparents! Woman celebrates massive excess skin removal! Cauliflower chocolate smoothie? Man’s penis turns to bone? Uncovering singer Camila Cabello's mental health tip is for a stress free day!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Treat It Now or Pay Later?
programme.desc: Actress Sally Field joins The Doctors to raise awareness about osteoporosis, a bone-thinning disease that affects four times more women than men. Learn steps to take to preserve the health of your bones.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: How far would you go for beauty? A controversial surgery alters feet so women can wear heels. And, an acupuncture facelift that claims to take years off a woman's appearance. And, the latest in laser surgery that erases tattoos.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Do you want to better your health, but can’t seem to find the time? The Doctors reveal 50 ways to improve your health, and each takes just five minutes or less! And, learn simple housecleaning tips that don’t cost a dime.

programme.desc: The Doctors go Live in the OR to witness a knee replacement surgery! Woman finds out if she’s been catfished! Viral TikTok star talks about her life living with alopecia! Missouri woman fights to keep pet monkeys she claims helps her with PTSD!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Take your sex life from ordinary to extraordinary! Get Dr. Ruth’s tips to pleasure your partner and make the most out of foreplay and lovemaking. Plus, get the recipe for the concoction that will make your man go all night!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Decipher the clues and warning signs your body is giving you. Witness a life-saving surgery that a mother and daughter underwent together! Plus, learn what kind of bruises can indicate a serious medical condition.

programme.desc: Have no fear this Halloween! The Doctors reveals tricks for treating your health! Dr. Ordon shares spooktacular at-home skin treatments. And, nutritious Halloween candy!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Bizarre in The E.R. - strange but true emergency room stories you won’t believe! And, a brand new dad was arrested for selling heroin in the hospital’s maternity ward! Then, should high school students be segregated at lunchtime by their GPAs? And, don’t look now ladies, but pimple-popping nails are in vogue! Would you try them?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Insta-famous fitness star Abby Pollock is known for her “peach booty” that’s so perfect some say it’s fake! A live glute ultrasound reveals the truth, while Abby shares a shocking admission about her past. When a bad habit becomes debilitating, a woman turns to The Doctors for help! Special correspondent Rosie Mercado joins The Doctors and is shocked to hear that people are putting apple cider vinegar… down where? Is there any truth to the internet rumor urging women to try DIY “tightening”? Could a contraceptive gel for men change birth control forever? Should you stay friends with your ex? programme.title: The Doctors

Soon after moving into the apartment, Sandy hires Aram to be her nanny while she takes on work for the first time since her children were born. programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: 2016 in Review - Abu Dhabi (2026)
programme.desc: The 2016 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix (formally known as the 2016 Formula 1 Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix) was a Formula One motor race held on 27 November 2016 at the Yas Marina Circuit in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The race was the final round of the 2016 season and determined the 2016 World Drivers' Championship. It marked the eighth running of the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix and the eighth time that the race had been run as a World Championship event since the inaugural season in 1950.Defending race winner Nico Rosberg entered the round with a twelve-point lead over teammate Lewis Hamilton in the World Drivers' Championship. Their team, Mercedes, held a lead of two hundred and seventy-six points over Red Bull Racing in the World Constructors' Championship. Rosberg required a podium finish to secure the championship; Hamilton required a podium to remain in mathematical contention. Hamilton started the race from pole and went on to win the race, while Rosberg finished second, securing his maiden World Drivers' Championship title. Sebastian Vettel completed the podium in third.A week after the Grand Prix, Nico Rosberg announced his retirement from Formula One, making this Grand Prix his last.[3] This was also the last Grand Prix for the Manor team, as the team folded before the start of the 2017 season.
