Carina and Doddsy battle heavy traffic to save a child’s life, as his distraught mother performs CPR on the side of the road. Taz and Amanda treat a dog bite victim who becomes unpredictable. MICA paramedic Glenice hikes to reach an injured teenager, after a selfie expedition on a stretch of rugged coastline ends in disaster.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda and Nicola rush to help to a terrified woman who is having a major heart attack. Medication will buy them time, but surgery is the only thing that can save her life. Leonard and Nat are called to a major traffic accident where a trapped driver is showing worrying signs of a devastating head injury. Doddsy and Carina treat a mountain bike rider with shocking facial injuries. Eamon and Mike play referee between an embarrassed allergy patient and his protective Mum.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Can Cam’s detective skills crack a critical case and help a young man with severe chest pain? A nervous drive to hospital for Leonard and Amanda, who’s laid back patient has major problems. Nicola and Risky are baffled by a woman’s bizarre symptoms. An out of control heart rate puts a Mum of 5 in the danger zone, and Ray helps a young woman who has been in a major car accident on a country road.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda has a surprise in store to celebrate Taz’s ten years in the service, but the party is on hold as they rush to help a patient who’s had a fall. Cam answers a dangerous callout to save a man in personal crisis. Carina and Doddsy are on edge as they treat a woman who’s suffering a severe allergic reaction after being stung by a bee. Mike and Eamon’s concerns grow for a newlywed couple who've been thrown from their motorbike. Ray heads bush to help a dirtbike rider in trouble.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A bumpy ride as Amanda and Taz rush to a foster Mum in agony. Flight paramedic Matt races to help a teenage student in a critical condition after high jump practice ends in disaster. Can Nat and Leonard convince their laid back patient to come to hospital, after tests show he may be suffering a ‘silent’ heart attack? Eamon works his charms on a distressed cyclist who’s had a run in with a classic Melbourne hazard. Cullen attends an horrific car accident that’s left a young driver trapped.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A gripping emergency airlift for a woman who’s suffered a massive stroke. Risky and Nicola assess a great grandmother in serious pain, but what’s causing it? A fun day at a waterpark turns into a nightmare, as single-responder Al finds a patient with suspected spinal injuries. A high-impact collision has flight paramedic Matt heading to the coast, where a grandmother and her two granddaughters are in serious strife. Cam and Doddsy’s patients refuse to go to hospital without their beloved dog.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a volatile man who’s been on a two-day drug bender, putting himself and staff at risk. Dr Jonathan’s patient has a shocking fracture after falling four metres from a ladder. Dr Luke examines a man who has collapsed at home and suffered deep facial bruising, but what caused the fall? Dr Emma calls in reinforcements to save a mum whose life hangs in the balance after a high-speed crash on a country road.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A grandfather of nine has a broken leg and massive blood loss after a motorbike accident, but his vital signs aren’t showing Dr Jana Alexander and Dr Jonathan Papson the danger he’s in. A teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. However, the potentially career-ending injury is not Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing jewellery from swollen fingers, which isn’t something he learned in medical school.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At Royal Melbourne Emergency, a young abattoir worker is in agony after amputating her fingers. Dr Bjorn Makein and Nurse Sarah Thomas must stop the bleeding if there’s any chance of saving the woman’s hand. Dr Emma West’s patient has major head injuries after falling down stairs on her way to a wedding. Dr Michelle Thornhill treats a cyclist who’s come off his bike while not wearing a helmet. Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A crane operator crushed under falling steel at work is rushed to Royal Melbourne Emergency. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats a pregnant woman who is semi-conscious and behaving erratically. Dr Michelle Thornhill reassures a man who has impaled a drill bit through his hand. But how will she get it out? Dr Scott Taylor recommends an electric shock to reset a father-of-two’s dangerously fast heartbeat.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Two teenage mountain bike riders who crashed in separate accidents are airlifted together to Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. One of the teens has an insulin pump for diabetes; Dr Jonathan Papson hopes the life-saving device hasn’t broken in the crash. Dr Scott Taylor treats a paramedic who is now a patient after she was bitten by deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse, then trampled.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, a pregnant woman survives a car accident. Now, Dr Emma West must stop the terrified mum going into premature labour. Dr Sarah Whitelaw and the team battle to save a teen driver who’s rolled his car, is unresponsive, and has serious head injuries. Dr Scott Taylor fears a diabetic man might need an amputation. A trail bike rider has crashed face-first. Despite his injuries, he impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his resilience and wit.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In Royal Melbourne Emergency, Drs Emma and Jonathan battle to save a father of two from bleeding to death after he’s thrown from a horse. Where’s he bleeding from? Dr Luke looks for the cause of a law student’s puzzling condition which has terrified her worried parents. Dr Michelle’s young patient is in agony from broken bones after a motorbike accident and doesn’t want his parents to know. Dr George has grave fears for a handy-man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete while helping a mate.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Heart stopping moments at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe after multiple heart attacks. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from his backyard hive. Everything changes in a moment as he races to attend a stabbing victim who has no pulse. Nurse Sarah searches for the baby’s heartbeat after a pregnant woman is injured in a car crash.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Every second counts at Royal Melbourne Emergency as injured people keep arriving. Dr Luke treats a tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks! Dr Jonathan is concerned for a uni student who’s fallen six metres from the famous Hanging Rock. Dr Michelle treats a young motorcyclist with broken wrists who’s kept his bike a secret from his parents. Dr Martin helps a mum of two with a painful burn injury caused by boiling pasta.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: The pressure is on for Mike and Eamon, who arrive at the scene of a car accident only to find their patient has been stabbed and is rapidly losing blood. Nat and Leonard help a golfer who’s feeling sub-par. Matt airlifts a motorcyclist who has a collapsed lung, after a head on with a kangaroo. Glenice meets a hero dog that raises the alarm when his owner is knocked unconscious after being thrown from her horse. Amanda and Taz’s patient has intense chest pains, but is it a heart attack?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Can flight paramedic Ray save the life of a high-country farmer with a dangerously blocked heart? Cam earns the trust of a toddler in trouble, after she suffers an allergic reaction. A volatile patient puts Taz and Amanda in the line of fire. Leonard and Nat treat a young Mum, terrified she’s been bitten by a funnel web spider. Eamon and Mike help a woman with chest pains and breathing issues, but what’s causing it?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam responds to a call from frantic parents whose son has fallen through a glass window and is bleeding to death. A father son weekend becomes a Dad’s worst nightmare when his little boy is struggling to breathe. Leonard and Nicola help a grandmother in excruciating pain with a fractured hip. A young man suffering a rare condition has Doddsy on high alert. Mike and Eamon are confronted with a shocking Martial Arts injury, and Risky stops by with a special little visitor.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Glenice rushes to the rescue of a scared elderly man who's been trapped in his bathtub for days after a suspected fall. Cam is called out to help a tiny patient in big trouble. A grave situation for Taz and Amanda when they’re called to an accident in an unlikely setting. Nat and Leonard help a nurse who has crashed her car into a bush and is showing worrying signs of amnesia, and later, Nat wins herself an unexpected admirer.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Al and Doddsy are called to a rodeo to help a retired cowboy who’s returned to the ring with disastrous results. Glenice helps a young couple fighting to save their 6-year-old daughter who’s suffering from a rare and shocking disease. Amanda and Taz get a lesson on making a marriage last from a couple who have been married for more than 60 years, and an unpredictable patient with a head injury has Cullen on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Carina and Doddsy are on high alert as they rush to the scene of an horrific car crash, where a young man’s life is hanging in the balance. Amanda and Leonard help an 11-year-old girl with a heartbreaking story, after a suspected overdose leaves her lifeless on the floor. Cam steps in when a distraught woman is convinced she’s about to lose her husband. Eamon and Mike turn on the charm for their elderly patient, and is Leonard’s baby about to make an early entrance?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Will Mike and Eamon need to break down doors to get to a possible stroke patient, who’s been collapsed inside his locked home for days? Cullen fights to save the life of a man who’s choking to death on a piece of ham. Taz and Amanda win over a volatile patient, who reveals a hidden talent as Carina and Doddsy are called to a case that hits close to home - a fellow paramedic who has been attacked on the job.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam’s young patient is pregnant with twins and showing signs of going into early labour. Will her twins arrive in the back of the ambulance? Mike and Eamon are also on baby watch as they help a young mother-to-be who has a scare at early stages of her pregnancy. A puzzling case for Nat and Leonard as they treat a patient with confusing symptoms, and a little boy with big dreams of becoming a paramedic pays a visit to two of his heroes, before Amanda celebrates a special milestone.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Rory Rodriguez of Dayseeker on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this moving conversation, Dayseeker frontman Rory Rodriguez joins Joel Madden to open up about therapy, grief, and fatherhood. Rory shares how losing his father and becoming one himself reshaped his life, how trauma informed his music, and how therapy helped him rediscover balance. A candid look at vulnerability, resilience, and creative healing through pain and art.

programme.title: Pitbull: Live at Rock In Rio (2026)
programme.desc: Pitbull performs at Rock in Rio, delivering global hits like Give Me Everything and International Love on a massive stage.

programme.title: King 810: Memoirs Livestream From The Crofoot Ballroom (2024)
programme.desc: King 810 performs Memoirs of a Murderer live in full for the first time since 2014 in an intense concert filmed at the Crofoot Ballroom.

programme.title: Jimmy Eat World: 20th Anniversary of “Futures” Live From Phoenix (2026)
programme.desc: Jimmy Eat World return to their hometown for a one-night celebration of the 20th anniversary of Futures, performing the album front to back at The Van Buren in Phoenix, Arizona. Featuring fan-favorite tracks (“Futures,” “Just Tonight…,” “Work,” “The World You Love,” “Pain,” “Drugs or Me”) and special hometown moments from the band.

programme.title: Sarah Barthel on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sarah Barthel—singer, songwriter, and one half of platinum duo Phantogram—for a candid conversation about using art to process emotion, the band’s obsessive pursuit of a singular sound, and the lifelong creative bond between Sarah and bandmate Josh Carter. They trace Phantogram’s beginnings (from beat tapes to breakthrough), balancing romance and partnership, channeling real-life heartbreak into “When I’m Small,” coping with family loss, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. Cameos of warmth (including Leroy the dog) and plenty of shop talk on writing, producing, and performing.

programme.title: Holding Back the Years: 40 Years of Simply Red, Live in Santiago (2025)
programme.desc: Simply Red performs a 40th anniversary concert in Santiago, delivering career-spanning hits from sold-out shows on their global tour.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter JP Saxe joins Joel Madden to talk about love, loss, and life through music. JP opens up about losing his mother and finding ways to maintain a connection to her through songwriting. The two discuss artistic validation, creative vulnerability, and the evolving relationship between writing and performing.

programme.title: The Specials: A Message To You (2024)
programme.desc: This episode of Record On explores how The Specials emerged from late-1970s Britain amid political unrest, racial tension, and economic struggle. Through rare footage and new interviews with Lynval Golding, Horace Panter, Pauline Black, Rhoda Dakar, and Damon Albarn, the film examines how the band’s fusion of ska and punk became an anthem for unity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Tim Kasher of Cursive on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Nebraska-born singer, songwriter, and director Tim Kasher, frontman of Cursive, joins Joel Madden to discuss nearly 30 years of indie rock evolution, the band’s new album Devourer, and finding meaning in creative longevity. The two explore the role of art, relevancy, and gratitude as artists grow older and stay inspired.

programme.title: New Order on Power, Corruption & Lies (2025)
programme.desc: Record On explores the making of New Order’s groundbreaking 1983 album Power, Corruption & Lies and its defining single “Blue Monday.” Featuring Bernard Sumner, Peter Hook, Stephen Morris, and Gillian Gilbert, the episode examines how the band evolved from the tragedy of Joy Division into pioneering electronic innovators inspired by New York’s club scene.

programme.title: Bob Dylan: Shadow Kingdom (2026)
programme.desc: Bob Dylan performs early songs in an intimate 2021 concert film, delivering reimagined classics like Forever Young and It’s All Over Now, Baby Blue.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week’s episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with James McAvoy. Born in Glasgow and raised by his grandparents in the Drumchapel housing estate, McAvoy landed his first screen role at 16 after actor David Hayman visited his school. He went on to become one of Scotland’s most recognizable exports, earning BAFTA nominations for The Last King of Scotland and Atonement.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Country-rock singer-songwriter HARDY joins Joel Madden to talk about bridging the worlds of rock and country, evolving from songwriter to artist, and why connecting with fans matters most. They swap stories about small-town roots, creative identity, and finding value in authenticity over fame.

programme.title: Knebworth Documentary (2026)
programme.desc: Liam Gallagher revisits Oasis' defining performance. The film features interviews, behind the scenes, and concert footage from over 20 camera positions.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Frank Turner: Live from Shamrock Rebellion (2024)
programme.desc: Recorded live at Flogging Molly’s Shamrock Rebellion festival in Las Vegas, singer-songwriter Frank Turner and his band The Sleeping Souls deliver a high-energy performance filled with punk spirit, sharp storytelling, and crowd-fueled anthems.

programme.title: Don't Go Gentle: A Film About IDLES (2026)
programme.desc: Don’t Go Gentle chronicles the rise of British punk band IDLES, exploring how a group of friends from Bristol transformed pain and vulnerability into creative power. Through candid interviews, raw live performances, and emotional moments, the film captures the band’s journey from small clubs to international acclaim.

programme.title: Jutes: Live From Los Angeles (2026)
programme.desc: Jutes celebrates his new album with a live show from Los Angeles’ El Rey Theatre, bringing fans into the room for an intimate performance.

programme.title: Reporting for Christmas (2023)
programme.desc: Journalist Mary is assigned a Christmas story on the beloved holiday toy, Mistle Toad, celebrating its big anniversary. Though wary of the assignment—since the manufacturer is a major advertiser—she's promised full editorial freedom. In the toy’s hometown, she meets Blake, the founder’s son, who’s hesitant to speak out against his father’s overly commercial vision. As Mary digs for the real story, unexpected sparks begin to fly.

programme.title: Christmas on the Menu (2020)
programme.desc: Josie Jennings, a celebrated 35-year-old chef, heads home for the holidays to the magical bed-and-breakfast where she grew up, now home to her mother Shannon’s new restaurant. When famed critic Tanner Rhodes—who once gave Josie harsh reviews—arrives to judge her Christmas cuisine, old wounds resurface. As sparks ignite, Tanner must right his wrongs and prove he’s worthy of Josie’s love by Christmas Eve.

programme.title: I'll Be Home for Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Veterinarian and part-time mayor Sarah heads a town council desperate to find a doctor to keep open the town's clinic. Their hopes are raised when a surgeon plans to visit for the first time in years for the Christmas holiday. The mayor's attempt to recruit the surgeon is complicated by their history (their high school romance) and his secret shame (that he has lost his confidence in his surgical skills in the big city hospital in which he works).

programme.title: A Very Corgi Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: All hard working single mom Lauren Bradley wants this holiday is a well earned rest. Her hopes are dashed when she runs into single dad Ben who asks her to help take care of a cute and cuddly Christmas present he's bought for his daughter. Through all the calls & interruptions work, she might just get the best gift of all, the holiday spirit.

programme.title: The Dog Who Saved Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Zeus, a Labrador Retriever and a former police dog (voiced by Mario Lopez), has lost his bark after his barking ended up blowing off a five-year investigation, ending him at the pound. He is adopted by a father as both an early Christmas present and as a hopeful guard dog for the house and his family. When the family is away at Christmas, the less than dependable but crafty canine comes through and saves the home from two bumbling thieves.

programme.title: The Dog Who Saved Christmas Vacation (2010)
programme.desc: The Bannister family, including former K-9 police hero Zeus (voiced by Mario Lopez) are back, and this time they're spending their holidays at a beautiful Rocky Mountain resort. But toss in an unexpected visit from cocky Uncle Randy and his foxy poodle Bella (voiced by Paris Hilton) along with a familiar pair of bumbling jewel thieves, and this holiday may be headed downhill fast! Can Zeus solve the crime, save Bella and hit the slopes, all in time for Christmas Day?

programme.title: The Dog Who Saved Holidays (2012)
programme.desc: It's a sun-soaked holiday season for the Bannister family as they travel to Southern California to stay with Aunt Barbara, who surprises them with a new puppy named Eve. Everyone is smitten with Eve - except for the Bannister's dog, Zeus, who sees what a mischievous animal she is. When Zeus sees Ted and Stewey, two thrifty thieves, trying to break into the family home while the Bannisters are at church, it's up to Zeus and Eve to join together to save the holidays for their family!

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Tail (2025)
programme.desc: This Christmas, Riley Harper fights to save her small-town animal rescue from closing. Across the ocean, Prince Edward of Arendale travels to America to secure a land deal—unaware the property belongs to Riley. When fate (and a lost dog tag) brings them together, sparks fly. But when Riley learns Edward’s true identity, her trust shatters. On Christmas Eve, Edward risks it all to save her shelter—and her heart.

programme.title: A Christmas to Remember (2026)
programme.desc: As Christmas dinner preparations unravel, Lauren welcomes friends Megan, Paige, and lonely coworker Nora into her home. Through heartfelt stories of life-changing Christmases, they rediscover the power of kindness, authenticity, forgiveness, and chosen family. As her husband Tom finally arrives and dinner is served, Lauren realizes that the greatest holiday gifts aren't found under the tree, but in love, friendship, and second chances.

programme.title: The Christmas Brew (2024)
programme.desc: Overworked Tori is tasked with convincing a small-town brewery to sell to her employers, BEVCO, just before Christmas. However, she’s met with resistance from Evan, the charming brewmaster and owner, who rejects the offer. Stuck at his family’s bed and breakfast until she can persuade them, Tori discovers that the brewery’s true value lies beyond its beer, teaching her that some things are worth more than money.

programme.title: A Christmas Post (2024)
programme.desc: Noah Harrington is hired to revitalize a reluctant small town. When he finds undelivered Santa letters from the 1990s, he teams up with local historian Tessa Findlay to track down the long-lost gifts and bring early Christmas joy. As sparks fly between them, Noah hides one letter—Tessa’s childhood wish to ring the town’s Christmas bell before the post office is demolished. Can he save the bell, his job, and their budding romance in time?

programme.title: Christmas Keepsake (2023)
programme.desc: Single father, Tom and his daughter, Grace make the big move from the sunny land of Australia to the quaint US town of Ashbury Grove. While exploring her new backyard, Grace finds a mysterious time capsule, containing a guide to a perfect family Christmas. The two tasks themselves with finding its owner which leads them to finding love and their own perfect family Christmas.

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: My Christmas Prince (2017)
programme.desc: Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

programme.title: Jingle Belle (2026)
programme.desc: Every year, high school sweethearts Isabelle and Mike delighted their small town with a Christmas duet at the annual Christmas Eve Pageant. After graduation, Isabelle left for Juilliard, leaving Mike behind. Years later, she returns home to write music for the beloved pageant and discovers Mike is directing the show. As old feelings resurface, they must put the past behind them and decide if they can make beautiful music together again.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Child Support Showdown and Dog Attack Drama
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a mother demands payback from her ex-husband for their older son's medical bills and car repairs, claiming he agreed to cover these expenses. He refuses ongoing support for their adult child who lives at home and is employed. Next, a student seeks $10K for pain and suffering, as she dramatically alleges being bitten by her roommate's dog.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Seeking $10K in dental bills, a nanny accuses an au pair of throwing a phone at her face and breaking her front teeth. The au pair suggests she seek dental repair at a more affordable location.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Wedding Bus Betrayal and Gun Violence Awareness Collision
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a bride-to-be claims she is the victim of a bait-and-switch when she rents a large bus but a smaller vehicle shows up and ruins her big day. Next, the leader of a support group for gun violence victims sues a fellow member after her ATV is wrecked during an emotional awareness ride. The defendant denies accusations of drunken recklessness.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A woman claims her neighbor's unleashed American Bully dog severely injured her dog, bit her foot, and caused her father to fall in the street. The neighbor insists that her smaller, 13-year-old dog 'Yogi' initiated the aggression.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Twin Tales of Assault and Retribution
programme.desc: A woman sues her ex-brother-in-law for damages from a violent street assault, while he countersues with the same allegations. The plaintiff's twin sister serves as a key witness as both parties seek thousands in compensation.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Child's View of Divorce Violence and Murder Trial Attire
programme.desc: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a man sues the mother of his child after she allegedly keys his car during a visitation and later assaults him in front of their son. Altercations are captured on video. Next, after her son is sentenced to life in prison, a mother sues his attorney for failing to return expensive clothes she gave her son to wear during the murder trial.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man alleges that his ex stole money from him while he was incarcerated; she claims that the funds were utilized for shared household expenses. Both parties accuse each other of assault.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Guns, Ice, and Unpaid Price, and Renovation Roulette
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a 30-year drywall veteran sues his ex-employee for the remainder owed on a truck and for a gun taken without permission. In the second case, both parties vie for the $10K court maximum as a landlord claims that a contractor, whom he has never met, performed unauthorized renovations and placed a wrongful lien on his property.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man returns home from a business trip to discover that his girlfriend, whom he relocated from Ohio to Florida with her teen son, has left him for another man. He accuses her of taking his property and of the unauthorized purchase of a $2,200 designer bag.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Scooter Standoff and Dad's Work-for-Debt Dilemma
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a woman sues her mobile-home neighbor over the sale of a mobility scooter and alleged harassment. He says that her repeated police reports ultimately led to his eviction. Next, an employer sues his former employee for quitting and failing to work off a sizable advanced payment. The worker claims it was a generous gesture, not a loan.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Following a collision between a woman's car and a 15-year-old boy at an intersection, the driver sues for damages caused to her vehicle and for emotional distress. Dashcam footage reveals the teenager's alleged involvement in a perilous, internet-inspired game of chicken.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Unwed parents sue each other for the $10K court maximum amid claims of assault, vandalism, and infidelity. With a second baby on the way, an alleged marriage-for-citizenship involving a Nigerian family member comes into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man accuses his ex-girlfriend of stealing their pet corgi and breaking their lease. The ex claims she had to move out due to his abusive behavior and insists that the dog is hers.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A blended family sues their landlords after their lease is terminated, triggering a legal dispute involving allegations of harassment, false restraining orders, and property damage. A road rage incident ensues, with the former tenants claiming they were forced off the road and verbally attacked.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Two mothers sue each other for damages following a fight between their 11-year-old girls, who testify in court. The young victim, fearing for her safety, reveals she strategically positioned herself within view of a ring camera, aiming to capture evidence and ensure her mother's protection.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Car enthusiasts clash over an unpaid debt for prized car rims, a failed barter deal, and allegations of aggravated harassment.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Love, Loans, and Laid to Rest and Baby Shower Drama
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after a brief relationship, a single mom sues her ex for payback of a $5K business loan. He insists they weren’t exclusive and that she knew he spent the money on his mother's funeral. Next, a woman claims the father of her children was violent at her baby shower. She says they were no longer intimate after the incident; he argues otherwise.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A woman sues her former friend, claiming that she only had $100 left to pay off on a car before it was repossessed. Countersuing for an assault, her ex-friend submits evidence of a mutually-violent altercation captured in a live-streaming video.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Two aspiring entrepreneurs from California accuse a man of failing to fulfill their order for custom t-shirts after full payment. The manufacturer claims mislabeled and allegedly 'unsellable' shirt issues are fixable.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Unwed parents battle over the right to claim their child as a tax deduction and contest ownership of shared property. Child protective services intervene to ensure the toddler's best interests are protected.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A driver burdened by parking tickets transfers ownership of his van to an unsuspecting friend to avoid paying fines. When he amasses more ticket violations, she repossesses the vehicle only to have it stolen; he sues for its return.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man refuses to pay the adoption fee for a sick Labradoodle puppy, claiming that vet bills far outweigh the animal's value. He admits to giving the pup away when the seller did not retrieve it and that he already has 22 other dogs.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a woman loses her job after being accused of drugging and assaulting her colleague during an overnight business trip.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, after allegations of gross misconduct on a business trip, co-workers battle for the court's maximum amount. Their dueling defamation charges hinge on conflicting recollections of that night.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A father seeks the court maximum of $10,000 from his 25-year-old son as reimbursement for bail and legal expenses following the son's arrest on Super Bowl Sunday for driving under the influence and carrying concealed weapons.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part one of this two-part case, a young father sues his ex-fiancée for the $10K court maximum, claiming false assault charges led to a sweeping restraining order preventing him from seeing their children for two years.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, ex-fiancées share conflicting narratives of violence, highlighting a chaotic Valentine's Day dispute that ends a week later with a young mother's hospital visit and competing police reports.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A family disagreement takes a drastic turn when a gun-wielding security-guard brother, citing self-defense, faces charges of domestic violence and assault after an altercation at their ailing grandfather's house.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Barbershop Battle and Dental Adventure in Colombia
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases. First, a barbershop owner accuses her former employee of breaching a non-compete agreement by launching a rival shop nearby, a mere three months after leaving her employment. Next, in search of discounted dental work, a couple flies to Colombia for a cosmetic procedure. They break up and proceed to fight over who should pay for the cost of their improved smiles.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Amidst an impending marriage, tensions escalate as a woman accuses her future stepdaughter of tire slashing and social media slander. While admitting to carrying a knife for safety, the stepdaughter counters with claims of an eviction, illegal lockout, and theft of her property.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part one of this two-part case, a pharmacist takes legal action against his neighbor, alleging an unrelenting campaign of harassment involving police reports triggered by accusations of illegal drug use, drug dealing, and violent domestic disputes.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, a longstanding neighbors' feud reaches new heights, leading to court appearances, protective orders, and a barrage of vulgar conduct captured on camera.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Sentimental Silicon Bust and Sancho Showdown
programme.desc: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her former friend for $3,500, claiming the friend's unsupervised 5-year-old son destroyed her decade-old breast implants, stored in a sealed bag in her bedroom. In the second case, a dispute arises in a friends-with-benefits relationship as neighbors clash over a car loan and reimbursement for lost dresses.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Competing lawsuits ignite between a tenant and her landlord, fueled by the loss of subsidized housing, drug accusations, and an eviction. Claims of property damage and accusations of running a puppy farm come into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: The $10,000 court maximum is at stake as an elderly landlord faces a terrifying arrest due to false accusations of gun possession. His tenants deny claiming that he aimed an AR-15 at them, while the landlord insists it was retaliation for his attempt to evict them.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Former friends sue each other for the $10K court limit, after an altercation at a bar where one woman stabbed the other two. Claims of self-defense and counter-claims of harassment are further complicated by the fact that one defendant is now married to the plaintiff's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A mother seeks payback for wedding expenses from her daughter's ex-fiancé after he ended the engagement. He attributes the failed nuptials to the mother's interference and a contentious prenuptial agreement.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Assault, Corgis, and Emotional Support Fraud
programme.desc: Former partners battle over competing assault allegations and the custody of their two beloved corgis, one of whom makes an appearance and charms the entire courtroom. Concerns about the dogs' welfare arise when the Judge reviews a video of an online challenge where a slice of cheese is thrown on a dog's face.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Family Legacy at Stake and Rental DUI Delinquency
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her ex-partner of 25 years after enduring a forced eviction and alleged abuse in their shared home, which she had lived in since childhood. In the second case, a yoga instructor returns from abroad to discover that the woman who rented her car for three years had a DUI and installed a breathalyzer in the vehicle.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Teenagers fight over an unauthorized 3-minute joy ride that results in a blown engine and sizeable repair bill. Blame shifts to the sports car owner when video evidence of a reckless, high-speed freeway ride is introduced.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In a canine custody battle, a man brings his dog breeder friend to court over Gizmo, a French bulldog. The dispute uncovers ethical concerns about animal welfare in the breeding industry.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a woman sues for damages to her car after a heated altercation between her grandson and the defendant. Tensions erupted when the grandson flipped off the defendant for honking at him for walking too slowly across the street.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, the conflict is reignited the next day when a knife is allegedly brandished, triggering a frantic struggle. In the chaos, the car sustains damage when the two parties engage in mutual combat ending in the arrest of both young men.
